ui.wans_magnetic_spellbooks.notor_scan.m: Applies Magnetizing I only to unmagnetized targets; preserves existing strength and duration
ui.wans_magnetic_spellbooks.notor_scan.r: Caster's next eligible magnetic primary attack: +25% damage, effective strength +1 (cap V); does not stack
ui.wans_magnetic_spellbooks.magnetic_dev: Development placeholder: casting, crafting and natural acquisition unavailable
spell.wans_magnetic_spellbooks.notor_sca: Marks one enemy and makes it glow. Applies Magnetizing I only if absent, preserving any existing strength and duration. The caster's next eligible magnetic primary-target attack gains 25% damage and +1 effective magnetic strength (cap V). Repeated scans refresh an unspent mark without stacking charges.
spell.wans_magnetic_spellbooks.polarity_: Can target ordinary enemies. If magnetized, consumes one actual magnetic level on successful activation for enhanced damage. Deals a charged primary strike and a 40% area shock; scans enhance only the primary.
spell.wans_magnetic_spellbooks.magnetic_: Charges for 0.6 seconds, then fires straight. Magnetized targets take 1.5x damage. Effective strength I-III grants one additional piercing hit, IV-V two; later hits deal 50% and 25%. Walls stop the beam.
spell.wans_magnetic_spellbooks.dipole_an: Magnetized targets take three compression hits and a finisher; unmagnetized targets take only the finisher. Nearby enemies take 40% of the finisher. Hits are at least 10 ticks apart; bosses need not fall.
spell.wans_magnetic_spellbooks.magnetize: Can target ordinary enemies and prioritizes nearby magnetized enemies. Links up to 3/4/5 targets; a single target still takes damage. Each receives one strike and a 25% afterburst. Magnetic strength enhances damage; only the primary receives the scan reward. At most four chains; no recursive chaining.
spell.wans_magnetic_spellbooks.polarity_: Pulls then repels. Deals immediate damage; a magnetized target hitting a wall or enemy within 20 ticks takes one bonus hit. The collided enemy takes 50% of the base collision damage. Direct damage works against immovable targets.
spell.wans_magnetic_spellbooks.ferrous_s: Creates an approximately four-second ferrous storm with eight pulses and a finisher. Each magnetic level adds 5% pulse damage, capped at 25%. Leaving stops damage. One active storm per caster.
